paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kulhbaang ka lam khin a, huai ah khangkham a-om nawnta kei chih, Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem Arabia mi leh i melma dangdangte kiang a akitut lai in; huai hun tan in kongpi kongkhakte tung nai kei mah leng;
heading: Nehemiah Kalh A Thusawmguk
english: Now it happened, when it was reported to Sanballat and Tobiah, and to Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies, that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates;)

paite: Sanballat leh Geshem in ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl ua, "Hong pai in, Ono Phaizang a khuate lak a khat ah i va kimu ding," chi in. Himahleh ka tung ah gilou hih angaihtuah uhi.
english: that Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come, let us meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.

paite: Huchi in akiang uah sawltakte ka sawl a, "Nna thupitak sem ka hi, ka hong paisuk thei kei; bangziak a ka nna nusia a, na kiang úa ka hong suk ziak a, nasep khawl ding ahia oi?" ka chi hi.
english: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease, while I leave it, and come down to you?”

paite: Huan hichibang ngen in livei ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl ua; angeingei in amaute ka dawng zel hi.
english: They sent to me four times after this sort; and I answered them the same way.

paite: Huchi in Sanballat in ka kiang ah hichibang in angaveina ding in asikha akhut a laikhak honsa toh ahon sawl a;
english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,

paite: huai ah, "Namte lak ah akigen a, Gasmu in achi a, nang leh Judate'n hel na tum uh; huai a ding in kulhbaang na lam hi: huchi in nang akumpipa uh hi ding in, hiai thute dungzui in,
english: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

paite: Jerusalem a nang tanchin gen ding in zawlneite leng na sep a, Judah ah kumpipa a-om chi in. Huchi in tu in hiai thute dungzui in kumpipa kiang a tut ding ahi; huaiziak in hong kuan inla, kihouna i nei ding," chi in.
english: You have also appointed prophets to preach of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.”

paite: Akiang ah mi ka sawl a, "Na gen bang a huchibang thilhih a-om kei a, himahleh na lungtang a kipan na phuahtawm ahi," chi in.
english: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”

paite: Amau lah, hih louh ahihna ding in, "Nasepna a kipan akhutte uh hatsak louh in a-om ding," chi a hon lauhsak a-ut ngal ua. Himahleh tu in, Aw Pathian, nang ka khutte hatsak in.
english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done. But now, strengthen my hands.”

paite: Khum a om, Mehetabel tapa Delaiah tapa Shemaiah inn ah ka hoh a, ama'n, "Tempul sung ah, Pathian inn ah i kikhawm dia, huchi in tempul kongkhakte i khak ding, nang that dia hong ding uh lah ahi ngal ua; ahi, zan in nang that ding a hong ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you; yes, in the night will they come to kill you.”

paite: Ke'n bel, "Kei bang mi, taise ding hon sa maw? Huan kua ahia, huchi a kei bang a om a, ahinna humbitna ding a tempul sung a hoh nuam ding? Ka lut kei ding," ka chi hi.
english: I said, “Should such a man as I flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”

paite: Ka ngaihtuah a, huchi in ngai in, Pathian in amah asawl kei a; himahleh ka siatna ding in hiai genkholhna agenkheta hi: Tobiah leh Sanballat in amah aguai uhi.
english: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him; but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

paite: Hiai a ding a goih ahi, ka launa ding leh huchibang a hih a, khial a, thutut gilou ding a thubuai aneihtheihna ding ua, kei ahon simmoh theihna ding un.
english: He hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, Tobiah leh Sanballat anasepte uh bang zel leh zawlneinu Noadiah leh zawlnei dangte, lausak hon tumte, theigige in.
english: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.”

paite: Huchi in Elul kha ani sawmnih-le-nga ni, ani sawmnga-le-nih sung in, kulhbaang zoh in a-omta hi.
heading: Nasep Zohsianna
english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, i melmate tengteng in huai azak un, i kim i vel ua om namte teng in alauta ua, amitmuh ngei uah nakpitak in alunglelta uhi; hiai nasep i Pathian hih ahi chih athei ngal ua.
english: It happened, when all our enemies heard of it, that all the nations that were about us were afraid, and were much cast down in their own eyes; for they perceived that this work was worked of our God.

paite: Huai lou in huai lai in Judah miliante'n laikhak tampi Tobiah kiang ah akhak ua, amau kiang ah Tobiah laikhakte ahong tung hi.
english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.

paite: Amah Arah tapa Shekaniah tanu pasal ahih ziak in, Judah ah mi tampi amah lam a kichiam lah a-om ngal ua; atapa Jehohanan in Berekiah tapa Meshullam tanu zi in anei hi.
english: For there were many in Judah sworn to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

paite: Huai lou leng ka ma ah athil hoih hihte agen ua, amah kiang ah ka thute atun zel uhi. Huchi in Tobiah in kei hon hihlau ding in laikhakte akhak hi.
english: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
